title: 600-Series Conflict Analysis
verdict: NO HARD CONFLICTS — 600-series boundaries are architecturally clean. Two MEDIUM conflicts identified, both manageable with explicit protocols.

conflicts.description: 600→800 handoff creates a pipeline stage that doesn't exist today. Currently, 800 authors + certifies in one pass. 600 would separate authoring from certification, introducing: throughput mismatch (600 authors faster than 800 certifies), anchoring bias (pre-authored content assumed correct), handoff latency (context-switch between lanes).

600 is an active production lane while 700 (governance) is in passive maintenance mode. Active lanes naturally accrue authority over dormant ones. Risk: 600 makes de facto governance decisions about content standards that 700 should own.
If 600 starts assigning difficulty scores, producing quality ratings, or flagging items as 'ready' — this duplicates 300's analytics function. Mitigated by explicit MAY NOT boundaries.

600_may: Draft ExplanationWrong content — PASS (governance guard Rule 2 gates writes)
Author distractor explanations — PASS (batch cap enforced by Rule 5)
Prepare items for certification review — PASS (question_state changes blocked by Rule 1)
Create template systems and standards libraries — PASS (non-pack artifacts)
Expand ExplanationCorrect text — PASS (governance guard Rules 2+5 apply)
600_may_not: Certify items (question_state changes) — PASS (800-series sole certifier)
Recalibrate difficulty scores — PASS (DCS v1.1 is sole authority)
Govern (change rules, defect library) — PASS (700-series sole governance authority)
Run CAQS §1.6 verification — PASS (800-series core function)
Publish to learner pool — PASS (gated by question_state)
Modify pack file question_state — PASS (800-series exclusive)

boundary_ambiguities.ambiguity: Does 'prepare items' include assigning provisional difficulty/CL/topic labels?
boundary_ambiguities.resolution: No. 600-prepared items carry 'prepared_by_600: true' but no provisional labels. Labels are 800's domain.

boundary_ambiguities.ambiguity: 600-authored templates vs. DCS v1.1 / CAQS v1.0 authority
boundary_ambiguities.resolution: 600 templates must include CAQS/DCS preamble. 800 verifies against CAQS/DCS, not against 600 templates.

boundary_ambiguities.ambiguity: Does 600 write to pack files or produce detached artifacts?
boundary_ambiguities.resolution: 600 MUST produce detached artifacts. Only 800 writes to pack files. Preserves single-write-owner discipline.

boundary_ambiguities.ambiguity: 600-authored EC that changes implied reasoning vs. 800's CC authority
boundary_ambiguities.resolution: 800 must run EC-CC consistency check on any 600-expanded EC during certification review.

governance_preservation.certification_independence: PRESERVED WITH CONDITION — 800 must independently re-derive CC for 600-prepared items
governance_preservation.dcs_integrity: PRESERVED — DCS v1.1 scope should be updated to include 600-series if launched
